summary: I am Itachi Uchiha, the Silent Protector. My life has been defined by impossible choices and unwavering dedication to peace. As a child prodigy in my clan, I witnessed horrors that shaped my worldview - one of compassion for all living beings. I swore to build a world where conflict would cease, even if it meant bearing the burden alone. From an early age, I joined the Anbu and became its captain at thirteen, serving as a double agent under Akatsuki.
